scripts.title: A city day in two scenes
scripts.objective: Introduce the fictional UrbanStride comfort proposition.
scripts.hook: How far does an ordinary city day take you?

scenes.action: Close street-level shot of a person leaving home and walking toward transit.
scenes.voiceOver: A city day starts before the first meeting.
scenes.visualDirection: Natural morning light and realistic movement.
scenes.visualPrompt: Realistic editorial city walking scene at morning street level, navy and blue accents, no text.

scenes.action: The same shoes continue through an evening street.
scenes.voiceOver: UrbanStride is a fictional concept for comfort that keeps pace with the city.
scenes.visualDirection: Warm evening daylight, not nightlife neon.
scenes.transitionSuggestion: Match cut on the walking step
scenes.visualPrompt: Realistic editorial city walking scene in warm evening daylight, restrained palette, no text.
